law.citation: Wikidata states that Vatovavy-Fitovinany (Q1462671), a former region of Madagascar, was dissolved on 2021-01-01. GeoNames holds Vatovavy and Fitovinany as first-level divisions in its place.

units.citation: Wikidata, this region's item, read on 2026-11-28: English label and item id. The GeoNames id is the region's row in the GeoNames country file.

membership.citation: Each district record is assigned to the region that GeoNames files the populated places inside its boundary under, counted on 2026-11-28. For each of the 6 records, at least 98 percent of those places are under one region.
